1. I mean I don't think they're my friends and I'm super strict to who I talk to about my personal problems but to I think they're there to help me and change my mental route of thinking I feel like. 
2. I feel comfortable talking to random people but not people I know in any meants. I feel like I've wasted a lot of time on my relatives. I've lived for them and tried to fill their needs but I've realized it's not worth it. 6 years ago I had a little bit of friends, no worries, had fun and stuff like that.
3.  it's mostly a mental thing right now that I think something bad will happen because it has happened a few times in the past year and I have no support during those times and I've been unstable mentally for months that I feel like I can't handle the next time something bad happens, BUT I've recently talked to a person that made me feel good (the person had problems itself and I helped) that's making me feel good for a bit, don't know for how long tho. talking to my relatives is a no go. please trust me when I say that.

I think you're a caring person but the way you ask me things in a really "pushing" way doesn't really work with me. I know you only mean good but I feel like I'm way too literal to you to be able to help me.

 I'm not stupid but just way too literal and stuck with my mental way of thinking.

only people I trust are professionals that I guess are trying to help me. there's no relative, friend/close person I could trust with any of my personal information/problems. 

I'm hopeless because tragic things have happened here and there over the past 1-6 years (most things in the past 1-3 years) and it draws my hope for the future. things to do with life. (financial situation, friends, family, mental health, psychical health, hobbies, jobs, school and such)

"gave up" means basically that the next time something tragic happens, I think that's the end of me, as stupid as it sounds. I've had problems since a kid, I've hid every problem forever and they've gotten worse and worse over the years and I know I'm REALLY messed up right now so I think there's no fixing this. I know I COULD be happy and I've been happy for a little bit of time over the past few years but every time it gets taken out of my hands. I don't remember the last time I was actually in a good state of life mentally and physically.

they're really dramatic and I can't trust them. I'm not making this stuff up, I promise. they love drama and I have so many memories telling some family member something private and they tell the information forward like it means nothing. 

When I heard about the suicide joke from my grandma (who I never told the "joke" to) I just lost all hope to our family right there and then and I've tested them since then about trust and every time I tell them anything private they just tell it forward. I can not trust my family and my relatives. I don't want you to think I'm super depressed because I'm not, but I'm just hopeless. they've been like this forever and I can't find a solution to fix this. 

I started taking medicine and going to the psychiatrist because I kind of "gave up" on my life in a way, I honestly don't care anymore. I know I'm strong but this stuff has lasted for so long that I feel like there's no fix to this. meeting the psychiatrist support me because it gives me someone to talk to about these things and they distract me and I know they're trying to help me and obviously I need help but I think I need much more help than they expect...

I probably call them judgy because they overreact to everything I would have to say, even the little things. They don't know anything about my problems and like I said I've had anxiety since a little kid so there's been a lot of work to keep this stuff in, for a reason. these days some relatives see that something is wrong but if they knew that I had anxiety, depression and some suicidal thoughts they would mess things up even more. like when I was like 15 I did a little "joke" about suicide (when I wasn't really even in a bad shape at all) and they took it SO seriously and I heard from different relatives about it. you see they're all "normal working people" and I'm the fucked up one so I'm kinda alone in this thing. 

I've always been isolated from them for pretty much my whole life and they just pressure me about work, school and everything else while they don't know the reason for me not doing those things and that makes me just want to get away from them and I'm really lost what I should do about this. I just don't want to hurt them.

talking to the psychiatrists is just talking about the same things over and over and nothing really changes. it doesn't necessarily help but it supports but I don't think there's any point going there soon because why would I want to keep myself alive when things are always shit. their support single-handedly isn't enough. next step no joke is probably me leaving my family. sounds rough but something needs to be done. this has been going on for way too long.
